summary: The exact candidate fixes the two source-level counterexamples: disabled CPU-tensor offload no longer invokes get_cpu_copy, and unsupported DeepSeek-V4-compatible CPU backup is routed to PD rebootstrap rather than abort. Its focused regression passes after failing on the prepared base. However, the exact commit fails an existing decode priority-queue unit test because it unconditionally forwards a new is_rebootstrap=False keyword, and the original distributed DeepSeek-V4 workload remains unavailable. Request changes for a green compatible candidate and retain the full-workload claim as unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: disabled offload invoked req.offload_kv_cache and unsupported CPU copy escaped as NotImplementedError; 2 failed, 2 passed.
Candidate regression: disabled offload skips CPU copy, unsupported CPU copy selects rebootstrap, DeepSeekV4 inherits the unsupported stub, and unrelated errors propagate; 4 passed.
On the assigned AMD GPU, exact-value supported MHA target and speculative draft KV backup/restore plus host-capacity boundary; 2 passed.
Independent related/adversarial coverage: 42 passed and 5 subtests passed, but the existing decode priority queue test failed because add() received the new explicit is_rebootstrap=False keyword.

gpu_execution.evidence: The repository GPU backup/restore test passed on one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950 capability 9.5) with ROCm 7.2 / Torch 2.11. This covers supported MHA backup mechanics, not DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool or tp8/dp8 serving.

remaining_counterexamples: test/registered/unit/managers/test_priority_scheduling_disaggregation.py::TestDisaggregationPriorityQueueing::test_decode_mode_assigns_default_priority_before_prealloc_queue fails because the candidate changes the call from add(req, is_retracted=False) to add(req, is_retracted=False, is_rebootstrap=False).
The original tp8/dp8 DeepSeek-V4 MTP4 HiSparse KV-full serving race was not run, so distributed runtime behavior and timing remain unverified.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4 weights and the reported tp8/dp8 distributed PD deployment were unavailable.
The single-GPU MHA test does not qualify DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool semantics or the original serving race.
No native source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
Source imports were verified from /job/repo/python/sglang; the prepared environment reported no separate native artifact.
